steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wow, she sounds like a beautiful lady!

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: It's just an artificial intelligence that imitates her voice.

steps.speaker: Lisa
steps.content: What a tacky art exhibition, even the guide has to be "beautiful." Looks are nothing compared to Enfer's accomplishments in art.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wow... She actually loves Enfer, right? But her words are so mean and aggressive.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: So, let me repeat. Hecate and Labyrinth enter the exhibition from the <color=#fb9259>oil painting section on the west</color>, Hella and EMP from the <color=#fb9259>sculpture section on the east</color>, and Lisa via the <color=#fb9259>underground staff area</color>.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Your first priority is to go deeper into the mutated area and retrieve the Chief. I'm counting on you

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Hoo, hurry up. Let's do this!
